summary: This resolution directs the President under the War Powers Resolution to end U.S. Armed Forces involvement in hostilities against Iran or its government or military unless Congress declares war or passes specific authorization, while preserving self-defense and intelligence activities.

scores.thoughts: The bill directs the President to terminate the use of US Armed Forces in hostilities against Iran absent congressional authorization. It contains no provisions related to appropriations, budgets, or levels of government expenditure. Any potential downstream effect on spending is speculative and not addressed in the text.
The resolution addresses military engagement and the War Powers Resolution. It has no provisions concerning tax rates, revenue, or tax policy.
The bill is exclusively focused on the use of military force and congressional war powers. It has no connection to healthcare policy or systems.
No provisions in the bill relate to firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
The legislation concerns US military involvement in Iran and does not address immigration, borders, or related policies.
The bill contains no language regarding reproductive rights or abortion access.

While the bill directs the removal of US forces from hostilities in Iran, it does not address funding levels, appropriations, or defense budgets. The topic specifically concerns spending changes rather than authorization of force, so the bill does not engage the topic.
No environmental, climate, or regulatory provisions appear in the resolution.
The bill is silent on welfare programs, entitlements, or social safety net policies.
No education-related content is present in the legislation.
The resolution does not address drug enforcement, decriminalization, or related policies.
No provisions concern sentencing, policing, or criminal justice reform.
The bill does not engage with tariffs, trade agreements, or globalization issues.
Although military actions can indirectly affect deficits, the bill makes no reference to debt, deficits, or fiscal policy.
The legislation contains no provisions related to LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
The bill addresses the use of US Armed Forces, not foreign assistance or aid programs.
No election integrity, voting access, or electoral reform measures are included.
The resolution does not address technology regulation, data privacy, or surveillance policy.
No labor, union, or employment provisions are present.
The bill does not engage with religious exemptions, civil rights, or anti-discrimination policy.
